display_name: NIS2 Incident Significance Scorer (Art. 23 Reporting Threshold)
purpose: Score whether an operational event meets the NIS2 Art. 23 significant-incident threshold (any of: service disruption ≥1h, ≥1,000 affected users, estimated financial loss ≥€100k, third-party cascade, malicious act, cross-border impact). Emits significance verdict (not_significant / significant / critical), fires 24h/72h/30d reporting clocks, and identifies recipient authorities. Root stage of nis2-incident-and-supply-chain-readiness chain.
